person.description: a human being, as this graph knows them

persona.description: instructions an agent runs with: the doc body on the same entity IS the instruction text

state.description: running, stopped, paused, disabled, retired, or held

surface.description: native: it runs in this process. managed: another process runs it

role.description: a persona assigned to standing work: what it is responsible for, and whether it is running. When it next runs is a @yaks/wake `wake` pointing at it, where it works is a @yaks/git `worktree`, and what it last decided is kernel `decided`

persona_read.title: Read a persona
persona_read.description: A persona as one markdown document: its own instruction text, then every document it includes in full, then one line naming each document it only mentions. This is the text an agent is given — where it goes (a file, a repo, a spawned agent’s system prompt) is the caller’s business.

persona.description: the persona’s eid, its id, or the name it is addressable by
